about: Every number this video shows or says, with its source. Jobber's 2026 Home Service Trends Report re-read on Oct 29, 2026 (of owners who use AI, 54% use it for quoting; 1,050 owners; Conjointly, December 2025). The notes, the quote lines and the prompt are examples, not data.

jobber.title: Blue Collar Strong: The 2026 Home Service Trends Report
jobber.quote: For those who've already adopted AI, usage is practical and task-focused: 54% use it for quoting, 52% for invoicing, and 51% for business writing.
jobber.useAiQuote: 52% of blue collar business owners now use AI in their day-to-day operations
jobber.method: a survey of 1,050 home service business owners across the United States, conducted through Conjointly in December 2025, with a margin of error of plus or minus 3 percentage points at the 90% confidence level
jobber.scope: Base for 54%: owners who use AI (the body text). The chart caption says 'among home service businesses'; the video uses the body text's base. Not cleaning-specific. Descriptive, not a correlation.
